items.question: With what substances should that body be continually filled in this practice?
premises: The practice begins from milk onward as a starting substance.
Various fillings are specified as the means of filling.
The prescribed action is to fill that body continually.
items.inference: Therefore, one should always fill that body with various fillings beginning from milk onward.
